visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman wearing a grey sun hat and orange sunglasses smiles next to a red Mercedes-AMG convertible under bright daylight. (2) The shot moves to a cafe window with 'Mercedes-AMG' and 'CAFE!N' branding; inside, a display features a black tire rim filled with red balls on a wooden platform. (3) Close-up views of food items including a 'Trackside Crispy Croissant' in a white box and a 'Red Flame Spicy Chicken Sandwich' wrapped in paper with price tags visible. (4) Red coffee cups with 'CAFE!N' logos and specialized AMG-themed labels are shown in detail against a coastal background. (5) Inside the cafe, several customers sit at a long counter with laptops, while the white walls are decorated with large framed photos of vintage and modern Mercedes-AMG sports cars. (6) The woman holds up a shiny silver insulated shopping bag with the AMG logo while sitting in the red car's red leather interior. (7) The car is seen parked along a rocky coastline with blue water; the woman walks towards the driver's side and enters the vehicle. (8) Close-up of the car's interior dashboard where a finger operates the touchscreen to select driving modes like 'Sport' and 'Sport+'. (9) Drone and handheld shots follow the red convertible as it drives along a scenic coastal road with mountains and clear blue skies. (10) Detailed sequence shows the black soft-top roof folding smoothly into the rear deck and the 'Aircap' wind deflector extending from the windshield frame. (11) The video ends with a title card showing the car by the sea and collaboration details.
